hero.titleAccent: from diagram to a real database

steps.label: From ERD to a running database

draw.title: Draw the ERD
draw.description: Create tables, columns and relationships in your browser with no install or setup. You can also import from an existing database or from SQL (DDL).

refine.title: Refine it together
refine.description: Edit the same ERD with several people at once. Changes merge in real time, and every save keeps a version.

run.title: Turn it into a database
run.description: Generate DDL from your design and apply it to MySQL or PostgreSQL. Development databases are provided for free.

features.heading: Everything you need for ERD design in one place

managed.title: Free MySQL and PostgreSQL databases
managed.description: Get up to 5 free MySQL or PostgreSQL development databases per account, and turn the ERD you drew into real tables right away.

editor.title: Online ERD editor
editor.description: Use it in your browser with nothing to install. Draw tables and relationships in Crow's Foot notation and manage logical and physical names together.

collaboration.title: Real-time ERD collaboration
collaboration.description: Several people edit the same document at once. You see each other's cursors and changes live, and edits are merged automatically.

connections.title: Generate an ERD from a database
connections.description: Connect to a running MySQL or PostgreSQL database and Crowfoot reads its tables and relationships to draw the ERD for you (reverse engineering). When the schema changes, sync it back into the document.

sql.title: DDL and migration SQL
sql.description: Generate CREATE TABLE scripts from your ERD and get only the changed parts as ALTER statements. You can also paste SQL (DDL) to import it as an ERD.

validation.title: ERD design checks
validation.description: Automatically checks 17 rules for design problems such as missing primary keys, duplicate names and foreign keys with mismatched types.

history.title: Version history and compare
history.description: Every save keeps a version. Compare any two versions and restore the one you want.

library.title: ERD examples and templates

share.title: Link sharing and feedback

roles.title: Workspace & team roles

sections.heading: About the Service
paragraphs: Crowfoot is a browser-based ERD design and collaboration tool with free managed databases for development.

sections.heading: Free Managed Databases
paragraphs: You can create up to 5 free PostgreSQL or MySQL databases per account, for development, learning, and testing purposes.
Data persistence is not guaranteed. Databases may be deleted, suspended, or changed at any time without prior notice due to service operating conditions.
Back up any important data yourself.

sections.heading: Changes to the Offering
paragraphs: The free offering — supported engines, per-account quota, capacity — may change or end without prior notice.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
paragraphs: The service is provided "as is". We are not liable for damages arising from data loss, service interruption, or the use of the service.
Accounts and databases may be restricted if the service is used outside its intended purpose.
